lines.trans: It seems Katya really likes me a lot.
Congratulations! What are you unhappy about?
What, do you not like her at all?
Well no, she is a very nice girl.
But I just broke up with Vika.
I do not need a new relationship at all right now.
Then do what you do best.
Kostya, I am already tired of running from problems.
That always only makes things worse.

examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'here, there', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Вот последняя банка, на, береги её.
examples.trans: Here is the last jar, take it and guard it.

examples.text: Вот молодцы, отлично испортили все блюда.
examples.trans: Well done, you ruined all the dishes splendidly.

examples.text: Вот это я сейчас серьёзно попал.
examples.trans: Now I have really gotten myself into trouble.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'well done; good person' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Вот молодцы, отлично испортили все блюда.
examples.trans: Well done, you ruined all the dishes splendidly.

examples.text: Очень вкусно! Ты большой молодец, Дима!
examples.trans: Very delicious! Good for you, Dima!

examples.text: Это не я молодец, это Айнура плов приготовила.
examples.trans: I am not the hero, Ainura cooked the pilaf.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'лично'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Отличная идея, я полностью одобряю.
examples.trans: Great idea, I completely approve.

examples.text: Отличная идея, я одобряю!
examples.trans: Great idea, I approve!

examples.text: Вот молодцы, отлично испортили все блюда.
examples.trans: Well done, you ruined all the dishes splendidly.

meanings.note: Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'портить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'ruined', paired with 'портить'.

examples.text: Вот молодцы, отлично испортили все блюда.
examples.trans: Well done, you ruined all the dishes splendidly.

examples.text: А я испорчу отношения с будущим мэром.
examples.trans: And I'll ruin my relationship with the future mayor.

examples.text: Дождь испортил нам прогулку.
examples.trans: The rain spoiled our walk.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'all', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Представь, унесли вообще весь сейф.
examples.trans: Imagine, they carried off the entire safe.

examples.text: Там все дома радуются и весело смеются.
examples.trans: Everyone at home rejoices and laughs merrily there.

examples.text: Всё нормально.
examples.trans: Everything's fine.

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'of dish' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: У Макса настоящий талант портить блюда.
examples.trans: Max has a real talent for ruining dishes.

examples.text: Вот молодцы, отлично испортили все блюда.
examples.trans: Well done, you ruined all the dishes splendidly.

examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.
examples.trans: A real chef feels every taste of the dish.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'where', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А где сейчас ходят Макс и Катя?
examples.trans: And where are Max and Katya right now?

examples.text: Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Where's my toy car?

examples.text: Где папа?
examples.trans: Where's Dad?

ходить.gloss: to walk, to go (on foot, regularly)

meanings.en: to walk, to go on foot
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to walk, to go (on foot, regularly)'.

examples.text: По всем признакам всё сходится.
examples.trans: By all the signs, everything adds up.

examples.text: По признакам всё точно сходится.
examples.trans: By the signs, everything matches up.

examples.text: Ребята, что у вас тут вообще происходит?
examples.trans: Guys, what on earth is going on in here?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'and', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Наш ресторан всегда остаётся лучшим в Москве.
examples.trans: Our restaurant always remains the best in Moscow.

examples.text: У нас работает команда профессиональных поваров.
examples.trans: A team of professional chefs works here.

examples.text: У нас обслуживание гостей на высшем уровне.
examples.trans: Our guest service is at the highest level.
